limits: This record covers the independently packaged core; terminal 0.11.1 has its own package reports and evidence. Local release-build Windows WebView2 used isolated app data, an independently packaged local terminal, isolated loopback SSH and CDP input. Three themes, terminal input, keyboard details, manual mark/navigation, search, narrow viewport and emulated 1.5 device scale passed. This does not imply a five-platform native remote release-package combination or physical pointer/IME/DPI/multi-display/screen-reader validation. Linux/macOS terminal interactive GUI, historical upgrade and netem special verification were not performed.
